message.content:
{
  "summary": "The influent pH analyser (AIT-101) is at its range limit at 14.0 pH, accompanied by high influent temperature (TT-101 at 62.6 degC), conductivity (AIT-102 at 17608 uS/cm), turbidity (AIT-103 at 1798 NTU), and flow (FIT-101 at 227 m3/h). This indicates a severe influent shock load caused by an unscheduled dye bath or soaping bath drain or a chemical spill in the dispensing room.",
  "likely_causes": [
    "A dye bath or soaping bath drained without the scheduled hold in the dye-house sump.",
    "Several dyeing machines finishing at the same time.",
    "Caustic or soda ash spill washed to the drain in the dispensing room."
  ],
  "checks": [
    "Phone the dye-house supervisor to ask which machines drained, what recipe, and how many cubic metres.",
    "Check the equalisation level trend (LIT-101 at 3.25 m) and the free volume left before the high-high level.",
    "Confirm the acid pump P-201 is running and the acid day tank level is adequate for the extra demand.",
    "Confirm the coagulant pump P-202 has increased its rate and the coagulant tank is not low.",
    "Watch the pH correction tank pH (AIT-201 and AIT-201B) and the clarified turbidity (AIT-401) for the next hour."
  ],
  "handover": "Influent pH analyser AIT-101 reached range limit at 14.0 pH at 10:00 due to a major influent shock load with high temperature, conductivity, turbidity, and flow. Shift actions included monitoring alarms, checking equalisation tank level at 3.25 m, and coordinating with the dye house.",
  "citations": [
    "SOP-01 1.2",
    "SOP-01 1.3",
    "SOP-01 1.4",
    "SOP-12 12.2",
    "SOP-10 10.2"
  ]
}
